channel_note: Channels follow backend/core/frame.py. {cyl} = cylinder number, [*] = all cylinders, {channel} = the sensor channel chosen at injection. direction +1/-1 = up/down, 0 = oscillation or channel-only change.

faults.name: IGNITION_MISFIRE

maintenance_action.text: Check spark plugs, coil and lead of cylinder {cyl}; run a lane check.

mitigation_inflight.text: Reduce power, monitor EGT of the other cylinders, avoid prolonged high power.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Cylinder {cyl} stops burning fuel: its torque contribution drops, so rpm falls and torque imbalance raises the half-order vibration; unburnt mixture lowers EGT {cyl}.

faults.name: COMBUSTION_INSTABILITY

maintenance_action.text: Inspect ignition (SI) or injector/injection pressure (CI) of cylinder {cyl}.

mitigation_inflight.text: Avoid lean operation and very low power; monitor roughness.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Cycle-to-cycle combustion varies in cylinder {cyl}; mean values change little but rpm jitter, EGT noise and COV of IMEP rise.

faults.name: DETONATION_KNOCK

maintenance_action.text: Check fuel grade, cooling and ignition timing; inspect pistons if sustained.

mitigation_inflight.text: Reduce power and manifold pressure, enrich if possible, increase cooling airspeed.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Reduced knock margin makes end-gas auto-ignite at high load: pressure spikes heat the heads and excite high-frequency vibration.

faults.name: IGNITION_LANE_FAILURE

maintenance_action.text: Troubleshoot the failed ignition lane (wiring, coil, ECU lane).

mitigation_inflight.text: Continue on the remaining lane; land at the nearest suitable site per the flight manual.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: With one ignition circuit the flame front starts from one plug per cylinder: slower burn, later heat release, higher EGT and lower rpm.

faults.name: INJECTOR_CLOG_SI

maintenance_action.text: Clean or replace injector {cyl}.

mitigation_inflight.text: Reduce power; watch EGT {cyl} and CHT {cyl} against their limits.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Less fuel reaches cylinder {cyl}: the mixture goes lean, so EGT and head temperature rise while total fuel flow drops slightly.

faults.name: INJECTOR_COKING_CI

maintenance_action.text: Remove and test/replace injector {cyl}.

mitigation_inflight.text: Reduce power; avoid high-load climbs; monitor EGT {cyl}.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Deposits reduce injector {cyl} flow and spoil atomisation: combustion is slower and later, so EGT {cyl} rises and the cylinder's torque falls.

faults.name: INJECTOR_STUCK_OPEN

maintenance_action.text: Replace injector {cyl}; inspect cylinder {cyl} and exhaust for damage.

mitigation_inflight.text: Reduce power immediately; land as soon as possible (fire and engine-damage risk).
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Injector {cyl} keeps delivering fuel: cylinder {cyl} runs rich and hot, fuel flow rises and the rail loses pressure through the open needle.

faults.name: INJECTOR_STUCK_CLOSED

maintenance_action.text: Replace injector {cyl} (needle stuck).

mitigation_inflight.text: Reduce power; expect rough running; land at the nearest suitable site.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: No fuel reaches cylinder {cyl}, so it behaves like a misfire on a diesel: torque imbalance and a cold exhaust on that cylinder.

faults.name: RAIL_PRESSURE_DECAY

maintenance_action.text: Check the HP pump, rail pressure-limiting valve and rail pressure sensor.

mitigation_inflight.text: Avoid high power demands; the FADEC may limit power.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: The HP pump delivers less or the relief valve leaks: rail pressure falls, injection takes longer and atomisation worsens, so EGT rises and full power is limited.

faults.name: FUEL_SUPPLY_LOW_PRESSURE

maintenance_action.text: Check the fuel filter, low-pressure pumps and lines.

mitigation_inflight.text: Switch to the auxiliary pump if available; reduce power; plan to land.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: The low-pressure supply cannot keep up: inlet fuel pressure falls, at high power the delivered fuel is limited, so power falls (SI engines also run lean).

faults.name: INJECTION_TIMING_DRIFT

maintenance_action.text: Check crank/cam sensors and ECU timing calibration.

mitigation_inflight.text: Monitor EGT; reduce power if EGT approaches the limit.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Combustion is retarded: less of the fuel energy becomes work and more leaves with the exhaust, so EGT and fuel per unit power rise.

faults.name: CARBURETTOR_ICING

maintenance_action.text: Check carburettor heating; review icing conditions.

mitigation_inflight.text: Apply carburettor heat if fitted; change altitude out of the icing conditions.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Ice narrows the carburettor throat: less air enters, manifold pressure and power fall gradually.

faults.name: AIR_FILTER_BLOCKAGE

maintenance_action.text: Replace/clean the air filter; check the intake for obstructions.

mitigation_inflight.text: Expect reduced full power; avoid dusty low-level flight.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: The filter's pressure loss grows with clogging: manifold pressure and air mass flow drop, so full power drops (turbo engines compensate with more turbo work).

faults.name: BOOST_LEAK

maintenance_action.text: Inspect charge-air hoses, clamps and intercooler for leaks.

mitigation_inflight.text: Expect lower critical altitude; avoid high-altitude high-power segments.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Charge air escapes between compressor and manifold: the controller spins the turbo harder, but manifold pressure stays below target and power falls earlier with altitude.

faults.name: WASTEGATE_STUCK_OPEN

maintenance_action.text: Inspect the wastegate/VGT actuator and linkage.

mitigation_inflight.text: Power is limited to roughly naturally-aspirated levels; descend if altitude cannot be held.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Exhaust bypasses the turbine: turbo speed and boost collapse, manifold pressure falls towards ambient, fuel and EGT fall with power.

faults.name: WASTEGATE_STUCK_CLOSED

maintenance_action.text: Inspect the wastegate/VGT actuator; check for engine over-boost damage.

mitigation_inflight.text: Reduce throttle to keep manifold pressure inside its limit; land as soon as practical.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Boost is not relieved: manifold pressure rises above target, power and temperatures rise, with knock risk on spark-ignition engines.

faults.name: TURBO_BEARING_WEAR

maintenance_action.text: Inspect the turbocharger bearings (shaft play, oil leakage).

mitigation_inflight.text: Avoid rapid throttle changes; monitor oil temperature.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Higher bearing friction absorbs turbine power: slower spool-up, lower boost at high altitude, extra heat into the oil, and a turbo-speed vibration line.

faults.name: INTERCOOLER_FOULING

maintenance_action.text: Clean the intercooler core and check its airflow.

mitigation_inflight.text: Avoid sustained full power in hot conditions.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Lower intercooler effectiveness leaves the charge hotter and less dense: power falls and temperatures rise.

faults.name: COOLING_AIR_DEGRADATION

maintenance_action.text: Inspect cylinder baffles and cowling seals around cylinder {cyl}.

mitigation_inflight.text: Increase airspeed, reduce power, watch the temperature trend.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Less cooling air reaches cylinder {cyl}: the heat balance shifts and its head temperature trends upward.

faults.name: COOLANT_LOSS

maintenance_action.text: Check the coolant level, water pump and hoses for leaks.

mitigation_inflight.text: Reduce power; land before the coolant limit is reached.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Less coolant flow removes less head heat: coolant and head temperatures rise quickly; oil temperature follows.

faults.name: RADIATOR_BLOCKAGE

maintenance_action.text: Clean the radiator core; check the airflow path.

mitigation_inflight.text: Increase airspeed; avoid low-speed high-power segments in heat.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: The radiator rejects less heat, worst at low airspeed and high OAT: coolant temperature trends upward.

faults.name: THERMOSTAT_STUCK

maintenance_action.text: Replace the thermostat.

mitigation_inflight.text: On a stuck-open thermostat, respect the minimum coolant temperature before take-off power.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: The thermostat stays open: the coolant runs too cold (or too hot when stuck closed); oil temperature follows.

faults.name: OIL_PRESSURE_LOSS

maintenance_action.text: Inspect the oil pump, pressure relief valve and oil lines; check bearings.

mitigation_inflight.text: Reduce power; land as soon as possible; prepare for engine failure if pressure keeps falling.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Pump capacity falls (or the relief valve bypasses): oil pressure drops, bearing friction rises, oil heats and thins, which drops pressure further until the bearings seize.

faults.name: OIL_LEAK_LOW_QUANTITY

maintenance_action.text: Find and fix the oil leak; replenish oil.

mitigation_inflight.text: Monitor oil pressure; land before quantity falls below the minimum.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Oil is lost steadily: quantity falls, then the pump starts to cavitate, so pressure fluctuates and falls while oil temperature rises.

faults.name: OIL_COOLER_BLOCKAGE

maintenance_action.text: Clean the oil cooler and check its airflow.

mitigation_inflight.text: Reduce power; increase airspeed; watch the oil temperature trend.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: The oil cooler rejects less heat: oil temperature trends upward and the thinner oil gives slightly lower pressure.

faults.name: BEARING_WEAR

maintenance_action.text: Oil analysis (wear metals); inspect the bearings.

mitigation_inflight.text: No immediate action; plan maintenance before RUL runs out.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Larger bearing clearances leak more oil: pressure is lower at hot idle, friction and the first-order vibration rise slowly.

faults.name: GEARBOX_DAMAGE

maintenance_action.text: Inspect the reduction gearbox (gear teeth, bearings, oil).

mitigation_inflight.text: Reduce power; avoid abrupt throttle changes.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Damaged gear teeth excite the gear-mesh frequency and add friction, so the gearbox runs hotter.

faults.name: PROPELLER_IMBALANCE

maintenance_action.text: Inspect and balance the propeller.

mitigation_inflight.text: Reduce rpm if vibration is high.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: A mass or aerodynamic imbalance of the propeller produces a once-per-propeller-revolution vibration; nothing thermal changes.

faults.name: ENGINE_MOUNT_DEGRADATION

maintenance_action.text: Inspect the engine mounts and isolators.

mitigation_inflight.text: No immediate action; avoid high-vibration rpm bands.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Worn mounts transmit more of every vibration order to the airframe sensors: all orders rise together.

faults.name: COMPRESSION_LOSS

maintenance_action.text: Compression / leak-down test of cylinder {cyl} (rings, valves).

mitigation_inflight.text: No immediate action; monitor roughness.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Leakage past rings or valves lowers cylinder {cyl}'s compression and torque, creating torque imbalance; blow-by heats the oil.

faults.name: EXHAUST_LEAK_EGT_IMBALANCE

maintenance_action.text: Inspect the exhaust manifold, gaskets and EGT probe of cylinder {cyl}.

mitigation_inflight.text: Monitor; check for exhaust smell / CO in crewed installations.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Exhaust leaks at cylinder {cyl}: its EGT reading deviates and turbo engines lose some turbine energy.

faults.name: ALTERNATOR_DEGRADATION

maintenance_action.text: Check the alternator/generator, regulator, belt and wiring.

mitigation_inflight.text: Shed non-essential electrical loads; check remaining battery endurance against the mission.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: The alternator cannot supply the load: the battery starts discharging, so battery current turns negative and bus voltage sags as charge falls.

faults.name: VOLTAGE_REGULATOR_FAULT

maintenance_action.text: Replace the voltage regulator.

mitigation_inflight.text: Over-voltage: disconnect the alternator per procedure; shed loads.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: The regulator holds the wrong setpoint: the bus voltage sits steadily too high (or too low).

faults.name: BATTERY_DEGRADATION

maintenance_action.text: Capacity-test or replace the battery.

mitigation_inflight.text: Avoid relying on battery endurance; keep the alternator online.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Lower capacity and higher internal resistance: voltage drops more under load and charge falls faster.

faults.name: GLOW_PLUG_FAILURE

maintenance_action.text: Replace glow plug {cyl}.

mitigation_inflight.text: Allow a longer warm-up before take-off.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Only matters at cold start: cylinder {cyl} misfires and smokes until it is warm.

faults.name: ECU_LANE_FAILURE

maintenance_action.text: Troubleshoot the failed ECU lane (power supply, wiring, ECU).

mitigation_inflight.text: Continue on the remaining lane; no dispatch until repaired.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: One control lane is offline; the engine runs on the other with less redundancy and small rpm/EGT changes.

faults.name: PROP_GOVERNOR_FAULT

maintenance_action.text: Inspect the propeller governor (PCU) and its oil supply.

mitigation_inflight.text: Avoid rapid power changes; watch for over-speed; set a fixed power if the rpm hunts.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: The governor loses control of blade pitch: propeller rpm hunts around the setpoint (direction 0 = oscillation) with over-speed risk.

faults.name: SENSOR_STUCK

expected_signature.note: only this channel changes; related channels stay consistent

maintenance_action.text: Replace or recalibrate the {channel} sensor and check its wiring.

mitigation_inflight.text: Treat {channel} as unavailable; use the twin's virtual value; if the channel is safety-critical (oil pressure, CHT/coolant) land as soon as practical.
mitigation_inflight.source: ANUMAAN-authored; check against the engine OM abnormal-operation section

faults.physics_explanation: Only the {channel} measurement is wrong; the engine itself is healthy, so physically related channels do not move with it.
faults.description: reading frozen at its last value
